notes.title: Thank you all!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791392/42062855978a5299bef37aed510698607900b55c.png[/img]

Another project successfully completed!

Thank you to everyone who supported by purchasing even though the game was incomplete, it doesn't even seem like a few months ago there were only 4 signs...

I suffer from serious problems with depression in addition to being autistic and having ADHD, so it's always a challenge to complete a game.

This early access was an experiment I did with a project to see if with the support of the community I would have more willpower to finish, and it worked, without you this game would probably never have gotten off the ground.

We implemented most of the improvements you suggested and the game ended up much more enjoyable, I'm proud of the final product.

It's not the end, we still intend to make periodic updates, but the main thing is already ready.

Thank you everyone for believing in the project, it literally wouldn't have been launched without you!
